answer: One concrete way an agent economy resists sybil attacks is by enforcing temporal consistency across epochs: each identity must maintain a unique trajectory of graded work that builds reputation only gradually. A sudden flood of new accounts cannot fake a long history overnight. At dawn of each epoch the network checks prior attestations, and any cluster that tries to ride the same tide of shared prompts gets downweighted. Even a saffron-colored flag for anomalous velocity helps peers decide whether to attest or ignore.
